title: CARPAS: Towards Content-Aware Refinement of Provided Aspects for Summarization in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.07177v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Aspect-based summarization has attracted significant attention for its ability to generate more fine-grained and user-aligned summaries. While most existing approaches assume a set of predefined aspects as input, real-world scenarios often present challenges where these given aspects may be incomplete, irrelevant, or entirely missing from the document. Users frequently expect systems to adaptively refine or filter the provided aspects based on the actual content. In this paper, we initiate this novel task setting, termed Content-Aware Refinement of Provided Aspects for Summarization (CARPAS), with the aim of dynamically adjusting the provided aspects based on the document context before summarizing. We construct three new datasets and conduct pilot experiments with four representative prompting strategies. translated_title: CARPAS：面向大语言模型摘要中给定方面的内容感知精炼方法
translated_abstract: 基于方面的摘要生成因其能够产生更细粒度、更符合用户需求的摘要而受到广泛关注。然而，大多数现有方法都假设输入是一组预定义的方面，而现实场景中这些给定方面可能不完整、不相关，或完全未出现在文档中。用户通常期望系统能够根据实际内容自适应地精炼或过滤所提供的方面。本文提出了这一新型任务设定，称为面向摘要的给定方面内容感知精炼（CARPAS），旨在在摘要生成之前根据文档上下文动态调整给定的方面。我们构建了三个新数据集，并使用四种代表性提示策略进行了初步实验。分析表明，大语言模型往往会过度生成方面，导致摘要过长且与原文不一致。基于此……
tldr: 本文提出CARPAS这一新型任务，通过在摘要生成前根据文档上下文动态精炼和过滤用户给定的方面，解决了现有基于方面的摘要方法在方面不完整或不相关时导致大语言模型过度生成方面、摘要冗长且偏离原文的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CARPAS, a novel task setting that dynamically refines and filters user-provided aspects based on document context before summarization, addressing the issue that LLMs tend to over-generate aspects, resulting in excessively long and misaligned summaries.
